synthesizedFacts.fact: Tretinoin can initially make pores appear larger due to skin purging and increased visibility of underlying skin structures.
Retinoids, including tretinoin, are known to increase collagen production over time, which can eventually reduce the appearance of large pores.
Excessive use of tretinoin or improper application can lead to skin irritation and potentially exacerbate pore visibility.
